title: Backup Coverage Ledger
user: A small-team operator who needs to know which critical data sets are covered, by which backup, and whether the backup can actually be extracted.
smallest_useful_product: Offline/shared YAML-or-CSV ledger with asset records, backup targets, last proof date, recovery instructions, expiry alerts, and a printable restore drill checklist.
success_measure: 90% of listed critical assets have an owner, recovery location, and a recorded restore proof within 30 days.
constraints: Local-first data, no secret material, exportable plain files, and clear disclaimer that a record is not a successful restore.
non_goals: Claiming that documentation is restore proof
